extraction_text: Subject to the provisions of this Agreement, the Company shall manage the plant, direct the working forces, plan, direct and control the plant operation, hire, promote and demote, discipline, suspend or discharge for just cause, relieve employees from duty because of lack of work and for other legitimate reasons, introduce new and improved production methods or facilities or change existing production methods or facilities, improve quality, reduce costs, and establish and attain reasonable work and performance standards.

The Company and the Union recognize that improved equipment, methods and procedures create changes in the job structure of the workforce. The provisions of this Section are intended to assist employees in maintaining and improving skills closely related to their present employment with the Company and/or to assist in preparing them for foreseeable jobs by reimbursing them for costs of approved job-related credit courses taken in accredited higher educational institutions.
